CommunityApplications.Profile: WAZ Cooling Control provides local temperature-based fan control for Dell PowerVault MD1200/MD1220 shelves and newly added, self-contained IPMI chassis control for Dell PowerEdge R730/R730xd. IPMI fan response, firmware handback and idle curve operation are confirmed on a Dell R730xd with Unraid 7.3.3. Supports independent Global/Individual curves, guarded shelf discovery, commissioning, SES telemetry and supervised recovery. AI-assisted development by OpenAI Codex under project-owner direction, hardware validation, and release approval.
